spans.s:
2 वह् (वाह्, उह् & ऊह्) carrying, drawing, bearing, holding
(—˚).
1 वाह् v. 2 वह्.
2 वाह् वाहते press, urge.

व॑ह a. = prec., also intr. flowing towards or through
(—˚). m. n. the shoulder of the yoked animal or the part of the yoke
lying on it.
वह॑त् f. vehicle or river.
वहतु॑ m. wedding procession, wedding.
वहनभङ्ग m. shipwreck.
वहनीय a. to be carried, drawn, or borne.
व॑हन्ती f. pl. flowing water.
वहल॑ a. used to the yoke (cow).

वहित्र n. ship;
 ˚भङ्ग m. shipwreck.
वहि॑न् a. = वहल॑.
वा॑हिष्ठ (superl.) carrying, bringing, or flowing most.
वह्निगृह n. house or place of the sacred fire.
व॑ह्नितम (superl.) carrying best (the oblation).
वह्निपतन n. entering the fire, self-immolation.
वह्निमन्त् a. containing fire.
वह्निमय a. consisting of fire, fiery.
वह्निशाला f. = वह्विगृह.
वह्निशिखा f. fire-flame.
वह्निसंस्कार m. the burning of a dead body.
वह्निसात्कृ burn, cremate.
वह्निस्फुलिङ्ग m. fire-spark.

वह्य॑ a. fit to draw or carry;
 n. portable bed, litter.

वाह्य a. what is carried, drawn, ridden, borne on (—˚). n.
beast for draught or riding, vehicle i.g.
वह्यक m. beast for draught.
वाहक f. ˚हिका carrying, bringing.
वाहतक v. बार्हतक.
वाहनायुध n. sgl. & pl. vehicle and weapons.
वा॑हस् n. offering, presenting, waiting on.
वाहस॑ m. Boa-constrictor.
वाहितृ m. guide.
वाहिनीपति m. chief of an army.
वाहि˚नीश m. chief of an army.
वाहीक v. बाहीक.
वाह्लि v. बाल्हि & ˚क.
वाह्लि˚क v. बाल्हि & ˚क.
